description: Common error and edge-case response fixtures across all desktop_analytics_app_sync endpoints (contract v1.2). These cover HTTP 400/401/404/422/500 error codes and edge-case success responses (empty pulls, duplicates, rejected events). Note: the legacy batched ingest endpoints were removed (strict-only, 2026-07-09) and now return 404; the former 426 upgrade_required responses no longer occur.

fixtures.name: auth_401_missing_header
fixtures.description: Bearer auth required (SYNC_API_KEY is set) but Authorization header is missing (§4.1).

fixtures.name: auth_401_invalid_key
fixtures.description: Bearer token present but does not match SYNC_API_KEY (§4.1).

fixtures.name: cursor_400_invalid
fixtures.description: Cursor string cannot be parsed as a v2 cursor token (§4.4).
fixtures.applies_to: GET customer-merges, GET menu-merges, GET menu-mapping-verifications

fixtures.name: cursor_400_unsupported_version
fixtures.description: Cursor parses but version is not v2 (e.g. v1 or unknown) (§4.4).
fixtures.applies_to: GET customer-merges, GET menu-merges, GET menu-mapping-verifications

fixtures.name: forecast_cursor_400_invalid
fixtures.description: Forecast sync cursor is not a valid numeric string (§22.4).

fixtures.name: ingest_400_envelope_validation
fixtures.description: Top-level envelope validation failure — events field is not a list or missing (§4.7, §7.2).
fixtures.applies_to: POST customer-merges/ingest, POST menu-merges/ingest, POST menu-mapping-verifications/ingest

fixtures.name: bootstrap_400_missing_required_fields
fixtures.description: Menu bootstrap ingest missing required id_maps or cluster_state (§9.1).

fixtures.name: mutation_400_batch_rejected
fixtures.description: Mutation commit received an array or batch instead of a single mutation (§19.4, §21.4).

payload.error: Exactly one mutation per request is required; batches are not accepted.

fixtures.name: mutation_400_malformed_event
fixtures.description: Mutation commit event body is malformed or missing required fields (§19.4).

fixtures.name: customer_mutation_422_unknown_revert
fixtures.description: Customer undo references a reverts_remote_event_id that does not exist in this scope (§21.6).

payload.error: Undo event references unknown remote_event_id 'nonexistent-event-id' in this scope.

fixtures.name: legacy_ingest_removed_404
fixtures.description: Strict-only (2026-07-09): the legacy batched ingest endpoints were removed and now resolve to no route. The response is Django's default HTML 404 page (Content-Type: text/html), NOT JSON — clients must key on the status code only and must not attempt to parse the body. Menu/customer/verification mutations must use the commit endpoints (§19, §21).
fixtures.applies_to: POST menu-merges/ingest, POST customer-merges/ingest, POST menu-mapping-verifications/ingest

fixtures.name: ingest_response_with_duplicates
fixtures.description: HISTORICAL (endpoints removed 2026-07-09, strict-only): ingest where some events are idempotent re-uploads (duplicate_count > 0). Duplicates appear in accepted[] (§4.3). The same result shape survives internally in the import_menu_assignment_baseline ops command.
fixtures.applies_to: HISTORICAL: POST customer-merges/ingest, POST menu-merges/ingest, POST menu-mapping-verifications/ingest (all removed, return 404)

fixtures.name: ingest_response_with_rejected_events
fixtures.description: HISTORICAL (endpoints removed 2026-07-09, strict-only): ingest where one event is accepted and one is malformed. Siblings still ingest (§17.1). The same result shape survives internally in the import_menu_assignment_baseline ops command.
fixtures.applies_to: HISTORICAL: POST customer-merges/ingest, POST menu-merges/ingest, POST menu-mapping-verifications/ingest (all removed, return 404)

fixtures.name: pull_response_empty_menu
fixtures.description: Menu pull delta with no new events — cursor is echoed back, events array is empty (§4.4).

fixtures.name: pull_response_empty_customer
fixtures.description: Customer merge pull with no new events (§8).
